Item: Offline experiment scope and run manifest
Dependencies: Project-owner approval D-01; approval of relevant research choices; immutable fixture version/hash.
Acceptance criteria: Every run states non-operational purpose, exact model/config, input digest, seed, solver/dependency versions, time limit and termination/proof fields.
Affected components: Benchmark runner/reporting only; no production API.
Required validation: Schema validation of manifest; repeat same digest/seed/config and confirm stable inputs; preserve individual results incrementally.
Effect: Research reproducibility only; does not change safety boundary.

Item: Independent validator for existing simulation constraints
Dependencies: Freeze legacy C-01, C-02, C-09 and C-15 semantics; project-owner approval D-01 is required to use them as simulation-only rules. D-24 is required before changing or extending co-location semantics; this validator freezes, but does not approve, any extension.
Acceptance criteria: Validator must not reuse either solver's private compatibility/candidate helper as its sole oracle. Check intervals and listed-train exclusions; duration/horizon; and exact unique scheduled/unscheduled ID partition. For work-order pairs, preserve current compatibility: different sections or different track lines are compatible even if their times overlap; same-section/same-line overlaps within the same department are rejected; cross-department overlap is accepted only when both assignments have co_location_allowed=true, have the exact same start and end, and share the same section and track line. Reject cross-department overlaps failing any condition. Check same-department overlap by the existing (section, track line, department) resource grouping; this is a model grouping, not an actual resource inventory. Include valid and invalid cross-department fixtures. Existing code does not impose a work-order-to-work-order adjacent-line heavy-equipment conflict; report this as a model limitation rather than inventing one. Errors fail closed.
Affected components: New benchmark/test validation module; solver output adapter only if needed.
Required validation: Independent hand-enumerated tests for different-section/different-line compatibility, same-department overlap, valid bilateral exact-window co-location, and invalid co-location (each failed condition), plus interval-boundary, train, horizon and accounting cases. Do not call solver compatibility helpers as the validator oracle; compare solvers but do not use agreement as oracle.
Effect: Research model validation only; not railway safety verification.

Item: Matched-input solver comparison and proof-aware reporting
Dependencies: B-01 and B-02; document shared input normalization/candidate constraints and objective mismatch before comparing.
Acceptance criteria: Both solvers receive byte-equivalent canonical instance/config; reports distinguish solver incumbents, independently validated complete-feasibility witnesses, maximum-coverage proof, objective-optimality proof, infeasibility proof, feasibility-not-established, cutoff and errors; no equivalence claim where constraints/objectives differ.
Affected components: Benchmark runner/reporting; no solver algorithm changes unless a separately approved task identifies a mismatch fix.
Required validation: Digest assertion for each pair; independent validator on every output; tests for all outcome/proof combinations; paired comparison excludes incomparable objectives.
Effect: Research comparison only; current API remains baseline-only.

Item: Historical Task 12 discrepancy handling in new reporting
Dependencies: Project owner accepts preserving saved measurements; read-only use of Task 12 CSVs.
Acceptance criteria: Do not overwrite old result rows; new reports flag two partial rows with differing outcomes and contradictory `classification=equivalent`; no hidden relabeling.
Required validation: Regression test classification derived from explicit status/outcome columns; compare new reconstruction against preserved source without modifying it.

Affected components: Benchmark documentation/reporting; optionally frontend only in a separate approved task.
Required validation: Review report fields/labels and sample UI copy; automated check for required metadata if report generator exists.
